**We The People**   
**Website Brief**

**Basic Functions/Structure:**

CORE MATERIAL: Our WTP Deck should be the basis of the website, with the Manifesto providing depth where necessary. Both Deck and Manifesto lay out THE IDEA \- as in the theory behind Citizens Assemblies \- and then how it will work IN PRACTICE with detailed steps/roadmap, explaining how Councils of the People (our name for Citizen’s Assemblies) will build with the Movement alongside it.

Other separate tabs:

- Principles / Vow \- everyone must sign/agree to these to join  
- Join us/Sign-up Page  
- FAQs  
- \[Donation/Fundraising \- maybe not in first iteration, but soon\]  
- Contacts

Notes

- Happy to leave the detailed wireframing open to your thoughts, as you said there might be something more creative to be done pulled from the Deck mainly.  
- Simplicity is key really, though love the idea of incorporating the sexier scrolling styles, as long as it doesn’t detract from the message/alienate people.  
- Would be great if it took users through the overall flow of the steps and then drilled down to detail only if they need it \- to give a clear overall vision and to accommodate users with different knowledge base (ie. those who already know everything about Citizens Assemblies, those who know nothing)

**Materials you have:**

- Manifesto  
- Pitch doc (not we don’t own the photos, but they are great so we could definitely ask the artists \- often from press award websites \- for permission if worth it, or other obtain licences for)  
- Vow  
- Principles  
- Current “logo” \- WE THE PEOPLE in caps

**Goals of the website:**

- Mostly explain basic steps/principles of WTP  
- Answer FAQs  
- GATHER SIGN UPS (esp. support in different areas, pull in the power of brilliant people’s skills at this early stage)  
- This is the net we’re funnelling people towards (from all the different places \- youtube, word of mouth) so the call to action JOIN US right now is the most important thing

**Tone/feeling**

- Give overall feeling of a journey towards unity, togetherness.  
- Feeling of fragmented, shattered pieces coming together  
- We Are Many, We Are One / We Are One, We Are Many  
- Bold action: Be Part of Hope\!  
- The dawn of hope, the dawn of the future, after a long dark night of division, hatred, disintegration.   
- Cool, revolutionary \- something exciting I want to be part of   
- A strong feel of Britain \- could be the flag, but especially the land \- both the geographical shape but also the deeper natural force/vibe of our land too \- the mountains, the forests, rivers, cliffs, meadows etc.   
- We used to use symbols of ancient sacred sites like Stonehenge and Avebury but took it out because it felt too hippy. Yet that is somewhere in the foundations. Some people think Stonehenge itself was designed as a symbol of unity of these islands. It’s the presence of our deep past.

**Imagery**

- See Pitch Deck for general feel obviously  
- People’s faces  
- The land of this country  
- Fine balance to find imagery that is our country/people/culture in a positive light but that doesn’t slip into identity politics of one side or another \- similarly with representation in people’s faces/identities \- gender, ethnicity, etc

**Brand/Colours**

- This obviously slips into our chats around logo etc which would be great to pick up sometime soon. The idea is to have something simple and non-devisive. Which is why we landed on the simple caps logo either in black/white, or we’ve currently chosen British racing green (Hex \#004225) as a potential primary brand colour \- suitably British feeling, without being too patriotic, and with bonus of it being green/earthy, without being too much in that direction either. If we were adding others it could be in this [space](https://piktochart.com/blog/british-racing-green-color-palette/): \#a05222d (but again, these were just gut thoughts, open to others\!)  
  ![][image3]

The palette of the dawn might also be part of it \- the yellows of sunrise.

**Target audience:**

- Literally everyone\!\! The impossible brief\!  
- So doesn’t want to alienate/intimidate anyone at any end of the spectrum \- effortlessly cool, but simple  
- Seamless on Mobile and desktop obviously

**Call to action**

- Sign up/Join us\!

**SEO**

- We can talk more about keywords and external links as we work through iterations, or obviously tell me if you need more now\!

**Style thoughts** (from [awwwards](https://www.awwwards.com/awwwards/collections/nonprofit-websites/)):

[https://www.giveahand.ai/](https://www.giveahand.ai/)  if you scroll to explore this, you could imagine people from all across a world (/uk) map coming together to form the logo of we the people or something like that to give the impression of all of these people having a voice…  
i guess the danger of all of this is being waaay too jazzy for the size of where we're at  
(especially given that it's maybe crashing my laptop just being open\!) but loved where it took me imaginatively

[https://theothersideoftruth.com/](https://theothersideoftruth.com/) this one is amazing. quite complicated/a lot going on/not completely intuitive/easy to read. And quite busy, but amazing

[https://blueheart.patagonia.com/](https://blueheart.patagonia.com/) really LOVE the simplicity of this. Feels like could be a great way to do our steps 1\. 2\. 3\. Pretty clean and nice use of multimedia, could be clearer at stages though \- a lot of images underneath words, too fussy in parts.

[https://www.no-fishing.net/](https://www.no-fishing.net/) this is badass (but i also love the cause) makes me feel like putting it in the scale of the world is so interesting. And maybe relevant to us. 

It's so interesting. the best of these sites have worked out what's at their core and then made THAT their means of navigation, which is what stops them being gimmicky and means they are more groundbreaking and fucking cool, representing deeply what WTP does. (That’s what’s really changed in the 6 years since I was doing this \- so forgive me that I’m just catching up with this\!) So HOW the website itself unfolds can directly reflect WHAT WTP is about \- like the pulling together of a millions dots/voices/ideas (disparate but distinct) like the giveahand one above, to create the shape of our country and the magna carta style constitution/or the UN-style roundhouse/O2 arena/stonehenge where everyone gathers, possibly even through a phase that’s uncomfortable/spikey which you can’t imagine how we’ll come out of harmoniously and yet we do\! Maybe the dots are even more like splinters/fragments of glass that then seamlessly come together to make a whole.

Anyway, probably for down the line rather than now necessarily, but wanted to share the musings\!
